headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs SPY YTD
summary: As of July 13, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 16.66% compared to SPY's 10.68%. This results in an average alpha of 5.98%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 43.55%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 9.32%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests the portfolio is maintaining its value effectively against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
